reviews.t: Cute speciality item
reviews.x: The set of soaps arrived in 2 days, a set of six soaps individually wrapped in the red box as shown in photo.  The box was in a cellophane bag, tied with ribbon and a label which included " mah johngg tile soaps designed by Barbara Metzer"  "made in China for Copa Judaica."  There is an ingredients label on the back:  sodium palmate, sodium palm kernelate, water, glycerin, titanium dioxide, sodium chloride, phenoxyethanol (antibacterial agent)  dexpanthenol  ( moisturizer), disod

reviews.t: Gift for Mahjong friend
reviews.x: This was an okay gift for my mahjong playing friend. A little pricy. Nothing really special. The symbols were kind of blurred on the soap. Would not purchase again.

reviews.t: The soap bars look good but don't hold up when used.
reviews.x: The soaps look very nice. However, I recently put one out for my Mah Jongg guests and after a few uses the green bottom part of the soap was soft and mushy while the top part was still intact and firm. I won't be using these soaps again. They were a bit too expensive to begin with, but now I feel they were a waste of money since I'll only be using the rest of them for decoration.

reviews.t: Great Small Gifts for MahJongg Players
reviews.x: You can break this set up - each soap is individually wrapped!  I gave them as small gifts to my MahJongg group.  Worked otu wonderfully!

reviews.t: Cute soap undermined by Very Cheap looking packaging
reviews.x: The soaps are cute little chunks, but the packaging is like something from the dollar store. There is no print or label on it, identifying the maker, the origin, the ingredients- nothing. It just makes me think there is something toxic inside. I bought it to give as a gift, but won't now. It isn't nice enough as a presentation.

reviews.t: Nice little gift for brunch attendees.
reviews.x: Fun little gift for my Mah Jongg winter brunch, ladies loved them.  I'll have to open mine to see the quality of the soap, but one woman was happy with it.  Individually wrapped, which I liked as I put them on each plate.  Price was fine enough, shipping speedy.

reviews.t: Hit of MJ Party
reviews.x: I had a mah-jongg party, and had various gifts for the first person at a table to mah-jongg. This was a hit! They are really cute and well-packaged. Very happy!

reviews.t: Messy soap.
reviews.x: They are pretty to look at, but are very messy soaps. The green lining melts all over the soap dish.

reviews.t: Fun but disfunctional
reviews.x: Top and bottom pieces come apart and don't know how to reattach to keep together

reviews.t: Wonderful Gift Item for Mah Jongg folks
reviews.x: I ordered these as a small token of my thanks for xmas to the Lady who introduced me to Mah Johgg.  She had the patience with me until I feel like I play with a bit more confidence.  They are beautifully packaged, bright colors on the soaps and perfect for my gift giving.  Hope they stand up to using in her guest bathroom with her Mah Jongg club.

reviews.t: Product looks just as advertised - just like Mah Jongg tiles
reviews.x: Product looks just as advertised - just like Mah Jongg tiles, even in size.  This was a gift for someone else, so I do not know how the soap is, but it made a great presentation and the person receiving the gift was very pleased. Unfortunately, there was a problem with delivery and product was received late.

reviews.t: Soaps look great & shipping was fast.
reviews.x: The soaps are much larger than actual Mah Jongg tiles but I didn't check the dimensions before ordering.  They will still make a great gift for the hosts of our monthly Mah Jongg gatherings & I'm sure will be a big hit (but no way to slip one into the game for a Pung, haha).

reviews.t: Product delivered is not as pictured
reviews.x: Not colorful like the picture and nothing like the designs shown. Dull brown and mostly Chinese characters. Very disappointing, would never give as a gift like I intended. Returned and doubly disappointed that I had to pay return shipping cost.

reviews.t: Mah Jongg Tiles Guest Soap Set
reviews.x: Absolutely wonderful!  I gave these to my sister - Master Maj Jongg Diva - as a Christmas gift - she was thrilled!  Soaps have great color, which, I guess,  is all that is really needed, as no one would dare use something so unique!

reviews.t: It'll do
reviews.x: Soaps are cute, but the coloring in the design is a bit smeared on some of them.  Hardly noticeable, though.  It'll certainly serve its purpose--a going away gift for an avid Mah Jongg player.

reviews.t: Somewhat disappointed in the packaging as it was not as impressive ...
reviews.x: Somewhat disappointed in the packaging as it was not as impressive as advertised. However, this was bought for a gift for someone who is a Mah Jongg player who may appreciate it very much.

reviews.t: who was extremely pleased. Soaps are exactly as described
reviews.x: Bought as a gift for a new mah jongg fanatic, who was extremely pleased.  Soaps are exactly as described, arrived in a timely manner, and enjoy a permanent place in the guest bathroom.

reviews.t: Great for mah jongg players
reviews.x: I bought these as a present for a friend who is really into mah jongg, and she loves them.  They are a really cute idea for the guest bath when one is hosting the game.

reviews.t: Lovely!
reviews.x: I bought this for a mah jongg buddy and noticed it in a lovely dish in her guest bathroom.  They are so pretty and wonderful for the right person.

reviews.t: Smaller than expected
reviews.x: The soaps were smaller than I was expecting/hoping for.  They are cute and smell good, though.  I gave 1 soap to each of my 3 Mah Jongg friends.

reviews.t: Smaller than expected
reviews.x: The soaps were smaller than I was expecting/hoping for.  They are cute and smell good, though.  I gave 1 soap to each of my 3 Mah Jongg friends.

reviews.t: Smaller than expected
reviews.x: The soaps were smaller than I was expecting/hoping for.  They are cute and smell good, though.  I gave 1 soap to each of my 3 Mah Jongg friends.

reviews.t: Perfect gift for my mah jongg teacher
reviews.x: Good friend taught me the game and this was a nice way to give a small token of thanks. Very nicely made. Look exactly like they appear.

reviews.t: Charming Man Jongg Tile guest soaps
reviews.x: These little guest soaps look just like a large man jongg tile.  They are quite charming.  The soap itself has a creamy texture.

reviews.t: Great quality.
reviews.x: Our Mah Jongg group is thrilled with these soaps, which will be used as a gift to our Mah Jongg teacher!  Great quality.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the soaps cute and a great gift for Mah Jongg players, especially as individually wrapped small gifts.
Several reviewers complain the soap does not hold up in use, with the green part melting, becoming mushy, or the pieces coming apart.
Some reviewers find the product overpriced or the packaging cheap-looking.
A few reviewers note the design or coloring is blurred or smeared on some soaps.
One reviewer reports the delivered product was not as pictured, with dull colors and different designs.
